topic: Renting a Power Tool at the Hardware Store

script.title: RENTING A POWER TOOL
script.story_hook: He wants to cut pavers, and rents the saw.
script.intro_zh: 為了切院子裡的鋪路磚，他來租一台鋸。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today's a hardware-store tool rental. Listen for renting and returning phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天是五金行的工具租賃場景。留意租借與歸還的說法。
script.outro: And that's a clean tool rental. Listen again and try each line aloud.
script.outro_zh: 一次乾脆的工具租賃就這樣完成。再聽一次，大聲跟著逐句唸。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a sturdy older man in his sixties with thinning grey hair, a thick grey mustache, safety glasses pushed up on his forehead, an orange hi-vis vest over a red plaid flannel shirt, brown work boots, and a stocky build
script.char_b_description: a busy young woman in her early twenties with bright pink hair in a neat high bun, a small silver septum ring, a red hardware-store apron over a plain grey tee, dark work pants, and a short petite build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need to rent a saw for the weekend.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ nid tə ɹɛnt ə sɔ fɔɹ ðə ˈwikˌend/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想租一把鋸過週末。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For sure. Cutting wood, or masonry?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ sʊɹ ˈkʌtɪŋ wʊd ɔɹ məˈsɑni/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。要鋸木頭還是切磚石？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Patio pavers, so a concrete saw?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪtioʊ ˈpeɪvɚz soʊ ə ˈkɑnsit sɔ/
dialogue.zh: 是院子鋪的地磚，所以用水泥切斷鋸？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. We have the walk-behind one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt wi hæv ðə wɑk-bɪˈhaɪnd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 懂了，我們有推車式的那一台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That big yellow thing out front?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt bɪɡ ˈjɛloʊ θɪŋ aʊt frʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 前面那台大大的黃色機器？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, starts easy, runs on gas too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp stɑɹts ˈizi ɹʌnz ɑn ɡæs tu/
dialogue.zh: 對，很好發動，也是燒汽油的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is it for a single day?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ɪt fɔɹ ə ˈsɪŋɡəl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 租一天多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty-nine a day, plus tax, of course.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti naɪn ə deɪ plʌs tæks əv kɔɹs/
dialogue.zh: 一天五十九，另外再加稅喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Do I need to book ahead?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ du aɪ nid tə buk əˈhɛd/
dialogue.zh: 好。要事先預約嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not today, we've got one open now.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt təˈdeɪ wiv ɡɑt wʌn ˈoʊpən naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 今天不用，現在還空著一台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. What do you need from me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt wʌt du ju nid fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。你需要我提供什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just your ID, we hold it as deposit.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst jɔɹ aɪˈdi wi hoʊld ɪt əz dɪˈpɑzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只要你的證件，我們先保管當押金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My driver's license is fine, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈdɹaɪvɚz ˈlaɪsəns ɪz faɪn raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我的駕照就可以，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'll scan it and hand it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪl skæn ɪt ænd hænd ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我掃一下，馬上歸還你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool. Is a blade already on it?
dialogue.phonetic: /kul ɪz ə bleɪd ɔlˈɛdi ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好。鋸片是不是已經裝好了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Um, the blade is sold separately here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ðə bleɪd ɪz soʊld səˈpɛɹətli hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，鋸片在這裡要另外買。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold? How much for the right blade?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld haʊ mʌtʃ fɚ ðə raɪt bleɪd/
dialogue.zh: 要買？對的那片多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That diamond one's about thirty bucks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈdaɪəmənd wʌnz əˈbaʊt ˈθɝɾi bʌks/
dialogue.zh: 那片金剛石鋸片大約三十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty? Wow, I thought it came free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝɾi waʊ aɪ θɔt ɪt keɪm fri/
dialogue.zh: 三十？哇，我以為是附送的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wish, blades wear down fast, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪʃ bleɪdz wɛɹ daʊn fæst ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我也想送啊，鋸片磨損很快的嘛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Makes sense. Can I buy just one blade?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪks sɛns kən aɪ baɪ dʒʌst wʌn bleɪd/
dialogue.zh: 有道理。我可以只買一片刀片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take it home, it's yours to keep.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs teɪk ɪt hoʊm ɪts jʊɹz tə kip/
dialogue.zh: 可以，拿回去，那片就是你的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll grab the blade too then.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl ɡɹæb ðə bleɪd tu ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 好，那刀片我也一起買。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call. Now, about the gas...
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl naʊ əˈbaʊt ðə ɡæs/
dialogue.zh: 這樣決定就對了。那再來講講汽油……

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gas? It's not already half tanked?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡæs ɪts ˈɑdi ˈhæf ˈtæŋkt/
dialogue.zh: 汽油？它不是已經有半箱油了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It comes half, you fill it up after.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kʌmz hæf ju fɪl ɪt ʌp ˈæftɚ/
dialogue.zh: 交機時只有半箱，歸還前你要自己加滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I return it with a full tank?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ rɪˈtɝn ɪt wɪð ə fʊl tæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 所以我還它的時候要加滿油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, or there's a refill fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ɔɹ ðɛrz ə ɹiˈfɪl fi/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，不然要加收油費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is that little fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðæt ˈlɪɾəl fi/
dialogue.zh: 那個小費用是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen bucks, plus the gas you used.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪfˈtin bʌks plʌs ðə ɡæs ju juzd/
dialogue.zh: 十五塊，再加你用掉的油錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, then I'll just fill it, thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðɛn aɪl dʒʌst fɪl ɪt θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那我自己加滿就好，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Here's the keys and a manual.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt hɪɹz ðə kiz ænd ə ˈmænjuəl/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。這是鑰匙和說明書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need gloves or goggles for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ɡlʌvz ɔɹ ˈɡɑɡəlz fɔɹ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我需要手套和護目鏡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We sell both, and a mask for dust.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi sɛl boʊθ ænd ə mæsk fɚ dʌst/
dialogue.zh: 兩樣我們都賣，還有防塵口罩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mask? Yeah, that dust is no joke.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæsk jeɪ ðæt dʌst ɪz noʊ dʒoʊk/
dialogue.zh: 口罩？對呀，那粉塵可不是開玩笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me about it, my last guy learned.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ɪt maɪ læst ɡaɪ lɝnd/
dialogue.zh: 就是說啊，上個客人可是學到教訓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha. How long can I keep the saw?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ haʊ lɔŋ kən aɪ kip ðə sɔ/
dialogue.zh: 哈。這把鋸我可以租多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A day covers twenty-four hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə deɪ ˈkʌvɚz ˈtwɛnti fɔɹ ˈaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 一天算二十四小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If my project runs late, can I call?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf maɪ ˈpɹɑdʒɛkt ɹʌnz leɪt kən aɪ kɔl/
dialogue.zh: 如果我工程拖到很晚，能打電話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call us, we can add a half-day.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl ʌs wi kæn æd ə hæf deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 打來吧，我們可以多加半天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Is it insured if I break it?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ɪz ɪt ɪnˈʃʊɹd ɪf aɪ breɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好。那我弄壞了算保險嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To be fair, you cover any damage yourself.
dialogue.phonetic: /tə bi fɛɹ ju ˈkʌvɚ ˈɛni ˈdæmɪdʒ jɔɹˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 實話說，損壞得由你自己負責。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. What if the blade just stops?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ wʌt ɪf ðə bleɪd dʒʌst stɑps/
dialogue.zh: 合理。那要是刀片突然停了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it back, we swap it no charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ɪt bæk wi swɑp ɪt noʊ tʃɑɹdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 拿回來，我們免費幫你換一片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. It's heavy, how do I load it?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɪts ˈhɛvi haʊ du aɪ loʊd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好。它很重，我該怎麼搬上車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a ramp out back, use it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə ɹæmp aʊt bæk juz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 店後面有斜坡，用它推上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ramp, got it. Where do I sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹæmp ɡɑɾ ɪt wɛɹ du aɪ saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 斜坡，知道了。我要在哪裡簽名？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just here, initial these two lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst hɪɹ ɪˈnɪʃəl ðiz tu laɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡，這兩行各簽個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This... and this. And I'm all set?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ænd ðɪs ænd aɪm ɔl sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 這裡……還有這裡。這樣就全部搞定了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All set, back by four tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl sɛt bæk baɪ fɔɹ təˈmɑɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 都辦好了，明天四點前送回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four o'clock. And I return it here?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ əˈklɑk ænd aɪ rɪˈtɝn ɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 四點。我還是送到這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same counter, tank full, keys back.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈkaʊɾɚ tæŋk fʊl kiz bæk/
dialogue.zh: 同一個櫃台，油箱加滿，鑰匙歸還。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it all. This is easier than I feared.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ɔl ðɪs ɪz ˈiziɚ ðæn aɪ fɪɹd/
dialogue.zh: 全都記下了。這比我想像中簡單多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most folks say that after their first.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst foʊks seɪ ðæt ˈæftɚ ðɛɹ fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 很多人第一次租都這樣說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, well, wish me luck on the pavers.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wɛl wɪʃ mi lʌk ɑn ðə ˈpeɪvɚz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那就祝我切磚順利吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll do great, take your time out there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jul du ɡɹeɪt teɪ jɔɹ taɪm aʊt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 你一定行的，慢慢來別著急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Where's the bathroom, quick?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks wɛɹz ðə ˈbæθɹum kwɪk/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。洗手間在哪裡？我很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back left, past the paint and lumber.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk lɛft pæst ðə peɪnt ænd ˈlʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 往左後方，過了油漆和木材區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. See you tomorrow around four!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt si ju təˈmɑɹoʊ əˈɹaʊnd fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。明天四點左右見！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye! Stay safe with that sharp blade.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ steɪ seɪf wɪð ðæt ʃɑɹp bleɪd/
dialogue.zh: 再見！那片利刃務必小心。

script.youtube_title: 【五金行租工具🔧】「鋸片要另外買」教你租電動鋸＋押金證件💵🪚🎧｜聽完就敢自己去租｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Renting a Power Tool
script.youtube_title_en: "The Blade Is Sold Separately" — Renting a Power Tool at the Hardware Store
script.youtube_description:
「鋸片要另外買」——週末想在家裡自己切幾塊地磚，去五金行租一台推車式電動切斷鋸，該怎麼問價、問押金、問刀片與歸還規則？這一集用 60 句連續真實對話，帶你從一天的租價、證件抵押、另購鑽石刀片，一路聽到加油規則、續租方式與歸還流程。

你會聽到：一天多少錢、要不要加稅；身份證或駕照怎麼當押金；刀片為何要另外買、大概多少錢；油箱只剩一半、歸還前要加滿；延後歸還能不能多半天、弄壞了算不算保險；還有安全裝備（手套、護目鏡、防塵口罩）要哪裡買。全程都是 A2 初級單字與美國人真正會用的短句：um、well、so、ha、yeah。聽完你就敢自己開口：Do I need to book ahead、Can I buy just one blade、Where do I sign。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，先聽兩遍，再大聲跟讀一遍，讓耳朵和嘴巴一起記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"The blade is sold separately" — weekend DIY means renting the right power tool at the hardware store, and every store has its own rules. This 60-line immersive listening practice walks through the whole tool-counter conversation, from rate to return.

You will hear: asking about the daily rate and tax, using an ID as a deposit, why a blade costs extra and how much a diamond blade runs, the half-tank gas rule and full-tank return, what happens when a project runs late, damage liability, and where to grab gloves, goggles, and a dust mask. Everything stays in A2 words with the small talk Americans really use: um, well, so, ha, yeah. By the end you'll own lines like Do I need to book ahead, Can I buy just one blade, and Where do I sign.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
難得的週末，你想把院子裡那幾塊破損的地磚鋸掉換新，可是家裡哪有推車式的水泥切斷鋸？五金行租一台要多少錢？證件要怎麼押？刀片、汽油、歸還又有什麼眉角？

這一集帶你走進五金行的租賃櫃台，從一天租價、證件抵押、另購鑽石刀片，一路聽到半箱油、加滿歸還、延長時間、安全配備與簽名流程，共 60 句連續真實對話。

script.thumbnail_action: pointing at a walk-behind concrete saw
